tree.text: To carry out this chapter, the Secretary shall, in accordance with this chapter, issue and, from time to time, amend orders applicable to persons engaged in—

children.text: the production and sale of porcine animals, pork, and pork products in the United States; and
the importation of porcine animals, pork, or pork products into the United States.

tree.text: The Secretary may issue such regulations as are necessary to carry out this chapter.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 1, 1986, see section 1631 of Pub. L. 99–198, set out as a note under section 4801 of this title.

ancestors.heading: PORK PROMOTION, RESEARCH, AND CONSUMER INFORMATION
